title: Aquanet
tagline: Water Quality Verified On-Chain -> Aquanet allows users to get real-time water quality updates through the on-chain data in real-time. This allows for more transparency in water quality to everyday citizens, as well as citizen scientists.
description: In September of 2022, Jackson, Mississippi, a modern American city experienced a water quality crisis that prevented its more than 150,000 residents from doing regular, daily activities like bathing, brushing their teeth, and cooking. To date, in November 2022, the water quality issue in Jackson, Mississippi has yet to be resolved. Unfortunately, this is not the only community that has been impacted by similar water quality issues, such as Flint, Michigan, the Navajo Nation, and numerous communities around the world. So I was inspired to change this issue by putting the power back in the hands of everyday people with verifiable water quality on-chain.
how_its_made: Built with FEVM, Hardhat, and Solidity. I had some trouble with Glif at first, but with some troubleshooting and help from the mentors, I was able to solve the issue. The issue was with the sub-accounts and test net funds. Once I solved that issue, it helped me to move on with the project.
